pop.title: Pop them!
pop.hint.pop: Press and hold a pimple to squeeze it.
pop.hint.strip: Squeeze the pimples and peel the blackhead strip off from the left.
pop.hint.stripBonus: Dotty nose: try the nose strip for a bonus!
pop.hint.stripPeel: Peel the nose strip off from the left for a bonus, then wipe.
pop.hint.wipePad: Wipe the goo away. Pick the cotton pad for a bigger, faster wipe!
pop.hint.cream: A little cream and the skin heals, clean and smooth.
pop.canvas: A cartoon face with pimples. Pick a tool below, then press and hold a pimple to use it. With a keyboard, Enter squeezes the next one with the right tool.
pop.escape.title: CLANK!
pop.escape.text: The visor slams shut and he runs off, unharmed. The armor wins again.
pop.fail.title: Hmph! They stormed off.
pop.fail.text: Too many Ows. Warm cloth first, gentle tools, and a little pause help.
pop.fail.skipNote: Next customer goes straight on, with no result screen, and costs {n} reputation.
pop.guide: Field guide: what to use on each bump
tool.fingers.name: Fingers
tool.fingers.hint: Fingers: press and hold any bump to squeeze it. Blackheads come out slowly. The two-finger pinch (Settings) works with this tool only.
tool.cottonPad.name: Cotton pad
tool.cottonPad.hint: Cotton pad: gentle, quick on whiteheads and gold, and pays a bit extra. Not for the rest!
tool.tweezers.name: Tweezers
tool.tweezers.hint: Tweezers: press and hold a blackhead or a hair to pull it out.
tool.noseStrip.name: Nose strip
tool.noseStrip.hint: Nose strip: tap the dotty nose to stick it on, then peel it off from the left.
tool.warmCloth.name: Warm cloth
tool.warmCloth.hint: Warm cloth: hold it on the face. Warm skin pops faster for a while.
tool.patch.name: Patch
tool.patch.hint: Patch: tap a popped spot to cover it with a little patch. Each one earns a small tip.
tool.patch.notYet: Pop that one first, then patch the spot.
tool.cream.name: Cream
tool.gloves.name: Gloves
pop.finale.hint: Squeeze every pimple and peel the strip off the nose.
pop.finale.done: All clear! The skin is glowing.

customer.gus.aside.4: He takes a deep breath, and then another, and then one for luck.
customer.cleo.intro.5: Kids' show today, {name}! They point at my nose, but I want a clean chin too!
customer.cleo.intro.6: We're filming a circus commercial, {name}! My close-up needs to be extra smooth!
customer.cleo.intro.7: I'm learning the unicycle today, {name}! If I fall, I'd like to fall smoothly!
customer.cleo.back.5: HONK! Cleo is back, {name}! I told the whole circus about your gentle hands!
customer.cleo.back.6: Honk-honk, {name}! My nose missed your chair. Okay, I missed you, too!
customer.cleo.back.7: Ta-da, {name}! I brought a balloon animal. It's a giraffe. Or a dog. Surprise!
customer.cleo.happy.4: Standing ovation, {name}! Even the elephants are clapping their ears!
customer.cleo.happy.5: Honk-a-doodle-doo! A perfect face, {name}! I'm tooting my horn for you!
customer.cleo.ok.4: A little bumpy, like a circus road. The show must go on! Honk!
customer.cleo.ok.5: Not my best opening night, but the nose is shining! Honk!
customer.cleo.ow.4: Ow! Squeak-honk! Oops, that was my shoe. Or my nose. Or both!
customer.cleo.ow.5: Ow! My wig jumped right off my head! ...Oh, it's still on. Ha!
customer.cleo.aside.3: She blows up a balloon, squeaks it flat, and giggles at the noise.
customer.cleo.aside.4: She wiggles her big shoes and they go flap, flap, flap.
customer.generic.intro.1: I have a job interview tomorrow, {name}, and I want to look sharp!
customer.generic.intro.2: I heard {name} is the best in town, so here I am!
customer.generic.intro.3: I have a class photo today, and I want to look my best.
customer.generic.intro.4: I'm meeting my friends for a picnic, so I'd love a fresh face.
customer.generic.intro.5: I lost a bet, {name}, so here I am. Please be gentle with me!
customer.generic.intro.6: First time here, {name}, so I'm a bit shy. Be nice to me?
customer.generic.intro.7: My face has a mind of its own, honestly.
customer.generic.intro.8: I only have a lunch break, so please be quick!
customer.generic.intro.9: My friend gave me this visit as a birthday gift, {name}. Surprise!
customer.generic.intro.10: It's my first day at a new job, and I want to make a good impression.
customer.generic.intro.11: My grandma is visiting, so I want to look good for her.
customer.generic.intro.12: I just want to relax and have a chat, {name}. Nice and easy.
customer.generic.deadline.1: The bus leaves in a few minutes!
customer.generic.deadline.2: The soup is boiling over at home!
customer.generic.deadline.3: The cat has an appointment, too, and she is already grumpy.
customer.generic.deadline.4: The parking meter is running out!
customer.generic.deadline.5: A pizza is arriving in a few minutes!
customer.generic.deadline.6: The sun is going down, and so is the mood!
customer.generic.deadline.7: The alarm clock is ticking in my pocket!
customer.generic.deadline.8: Hurry, there is a big sneeze coming!
customer.generic.happy.2: *gasps* Look at that! You've made me so happy, {name}!
customer.generic.happy.3: Is that really my face? Wow, {name}, I hardly recognise it!
customer.generic.happy.4: Does a happy little dance, twirl and all!
customer.generic.happy.5: I'm telling all my friends about you, {name}!
customer.generic.happy.6: Glows, quite literally, like a tiny lamp!
customer.generic.ok.1: Not bad, not bad at all.
customer.generic.ok.2: A little tender, but I like it.
customer.generic.ok.4: It tickled a bit, but that's fine by me!
customer.generic.ok.5: Better than when I came in, that's for sure.
customer.generic.ow.1: Ow! My cheek has feelings, you know!
customer.generic.ow.2: Eek! Ha ha, ow, that was a squeaky one!
customer.generic.ow.4: I saw stars, and not the good kind.
customer.generic.ow.5: *rubs face* Heh, ow, but that made me giggle.
customer.walkin.intro.1: I'm going to a fancy dress party as myself, so I want to be a good version!
customer.walkin.intro.2: My dog keeps staring at my chin, {name}. It's getting awkward.
customer.walkin.intro.3: I won a free visit in a raffle! Lucky me, lucky face!
customer.walkin.intro.4: Big family photo this weekend, and I always end up in the front row.
customer.walkin.intro.5: My mirror and I need to talk, {name}. You can be the referee.
customer.walkin.intro.6: I'm singing in the choir on Sunday, and everyone looks at the singers.
customer.walkin.back.1: Back again, {name}! You know my face better than I do.
customer.walkin.back.2: Me again! My friends keep asking who did my face last time.
customer.walkin.back.3: Hello again, {name}! Same chair? I like that chair.
customer.walkin.back.4: I'm back! My face had such a nice time last visit.
customer.walkin.back.5: Remember me, {name}? My cheeks certainly remember you.
customer.walkin.back.6: Here I am again! I've been telling everyone about this place.
customer.walkin.aside.1: Takes a deep breath and gets comfy in the chair.
customer.walkin.aside.2: Wiggles their toes to stay calm.
customer.walkin.aside.3: Tries very hard not to giggle.
customer.walkin.aside.4: Hums a little tune to stay relaxed.
customer.walkin.aside.5: Closes both eyes and holds on to the armrests.
customer.walkin.aside.6: Asks if the chair also does massages. It does not.
customer.walkin.aside.7: Brought a magazine, but only looks at the pictures.
customer.walkin.aside.8: Gives the lamp a friendly little wave.
customer.walkin.intro.7: Our team photo is on Friday, and I always stand in the middle. No pressure!
customer.walkin.intro.8: My best friend says my face needs a spa day, and she is very persuasive.
customer.walkin.intro.9: I'm going to a reunion, {name}. I want everyone to say I haven't changed, but better.
customer.walkin.intro.10: My neighbour just got a fancy new face cream, so now I'm competing.
customer.walkin.intro.11: I'm riding a hot-air balloon tomorrow, and everyone below will see my face!
customer.walkin.intro.12: The paper photographs my garden contest entry, {name}. The tomatoes are ready. Am I?
customer.walkin.back.7: Hello again, {name}! The chair remembers me. I can tell.
customer.walkin.back.8: Back for round two, {name}! My face survived and wants more.
customer.walkin.back.9: It's me! Last time my face felt like a brand new face.
customer.walkin.back.10: I told my dog about you, {name}. He wagged. That's a five-star review.
customer.walkin.aside.9: Reads the poster on the wall, twice, very carefully.
customer.walkin.aside.10: Sits up very straight, then slowly slides back into the cushion.
customer.walkin.aside.11: Counts the ceiling tiles. There are lots.
customer.walkin.aside.12: Pats the armrest as if it were a friendly pet.
customer.walkin.aside.13: Looks around the room and smiles at a houseplant.
customer.walkin.aside.14: Hums along to the music, slightly off key.
customer.hurry.intro.1: Hurry, hurry, hurry, {name}! I'm due somewhere very soon!
customer.hurry.intro.2: Quick, {name}! I parked in a very naughty spot!
customer.hurry.intro.3: Hurry, hurry! My taxi is waiting outside with the meter running!
customer.hurry.intro.4: No time to chat, {name}! Pop fast, I have a train to catch!
customer.hurry.intro.5: Speedy service, please! My lunch break is nearly over!
customer.hurry.intro.6: Hurry, hurry, hurry! The ice cream in my bag is melting!
comic.placeholder.title: Placeholder strip
comic.placeholder.p1.cap: Meanwhile, in a very ordinary living room...
comic.placeholder.p1.her: Hi! I'm {name}, and I have happy hands.
comic.placeholder.p1.him: Uh oh. I know that look.
comic.placeholder.p3.him: There must be a way to stop her...
comic.test.title: Happy hands (test strip)
comic.test.p1.cap: Meet {name}: kind, clever, and blessed with very happy hands.
comic.test.p1.her: Ooh, honey! Is that a teeny bump on your chin?
comic.test.p2.her: Hold still, my love. Very, very still...
comic.test.p6.him: That's it, {name}. From now on, there is a RULE.
comic.test.p6.her: A rule? For sweet little me?
comic.test.p7.cap: And so began... the Great Popping Ban.
comic.test.p8.end: (He did not hear the tiny pop.)
comic.s0.title: Happy hands
comic.s0.p1.cap: Meet {name}: kind, clever, and blessed with very happy hands.
comic.s0.p1.him: Sweetie. That's the fourth roll today.
comic.s0.p5.her: Ooh, honey! Is that a teeny bump on your chin?
comic.s0.p9.cap: And so began... the Great Popping Ban.
comic.s0.p11.end: (He did not hear the tiny pop. Yet.)
comic.s1.title: The secret
comic.s1.p1.cap: The Great Popping Ban, night one.
comic.s1.p1.her: Rules are rules. Go to sleep, {name}. Sleep...
comic.s1.p2.her: Just one bubble. Very... very... slowly...
comic.s1.p3.him: Mmf... why is the bed glowing?
comic.s1.p5.her: Meet Decoy {name}. Same hair. Sleeps like a log.
comic.s1.p8.him: Honey? Did you hear a pop?
comic.s1.p9.her: It's not what it looks like!
comic.s1.p9.him: It looks like a wardrobe full of bubble wrap.
comic.s1.p10.her: Will you ever trust me again?
comic.s1.p10.end: (Decoy {name} now sleeps on his side. On guard.)
comic.s2.title: Sir Zitsalot
comic.s2.p3.her: The rule says: not in the HOUSE...
comic.s2.p4.her: I haven't even said anything yet!
comic.s2.p9.cap: The armor always wins. Now with a shield.
comic.s2.p10.him: That's it. I'm getting a moat.
comic.s2.p10.end: (He still kissed her goodbye. Through the visor. Clank.)
comic.s3.title: The meeting
comic.s3.p1.cap: Tuesday night. After the armor won, {name} went looking for help.
comic.s3.p1.her: Um... is this the support group?
comic.s3.p1.greta: Come in, dear! The coffee's on. The urn only bites a little.
comic.s3.p2.greta: Welcome! I knitted you a cup cozy while you parked.
comic.s3.p3.penny: Penny! I peel every sticker. Even on bananas.
comic.s3.p4.greta: Who would like to share today?
comic.s3.p4.her: Not me. Not me. Not me.
comic.s3.p5.penny: Your turn! Hold the talking sock. Greta made it.
comic.s3.p6.her: Hi. I'm {name}. And I... pop things.
comic.s3.p7.her: Spots! Bumps! Pimples! I want to pop them... for a living!
comic.s3.p8.cap: Silence. Even the coffee urn stopped bubbling.
comic.s3.p10.him: Good. A nice lady knitted me a hat.
comic.s3.p10.end: (Greta has already started on the matching socks.)
comic.s4.title: Rock bottom
comic.s4.p1.cap: A few days after the meeting. Nothing happened. {name} sank deeper into the sofa.
comic.s4.p3.cap: The tea went cold on Tuesday.
comic.s4.p5.cap: Down the hall, Sir Zitsalot slept in his new bedtime armor.
comic.s4.p7.her: People pay for haircuts. People pay for nails...
comic.s4.p8.her: I will do it for a living!
comic.s4.p9.tea: Go. I'll keep your seat warm.
comic.s5.title: The shabby studio
comic.s5.p1.cap: Opening day! One chair, one bucket, one lamp. And a sign that says CLEAN!
comic.s5.p4.him2: Just popping in. Good luck, love!
comic.s5.p5.greta: Yoo-hoo! Your first customers, dear! And a little scarf for the plant!
comic.s5.p7.cap: Under the wobbly lamp. Drip... drip... drip...
comic.s5.p11.insp: A bucket. A leak. And that sign is telling fibs.
comic.s5.p12.insp: Gloves. Always gloves. Fix that roof, and you may stay open.
comic.s5.p12.end: Day one: one customer, one bucket, one box of gloves.
comic.plan.title: The plan
comic.plan.p1.cap: The next morning, {name} brought a plan to breakfast.
comic.plan.p1.him: Is that a pimple... the size of a house?
comic.plan.p2.him: Love... who pays to be popped?
comic.plan.p2.her: 212 videos say: everyone. They just don't know it yet!
comic.plan.p2.him2: Then I'm your first test... no. Your guard!
comic.plan.p3.cap: That afternoon: the only shop in town they could afford.
comic.plan.p4.cap: Everyone else saw a dump. {name} saw...
comic.plan.p5.landlord: No refunds, roof not included, sign here, here and here!
comic.plan.p5.him: Love... the roof is not included.
comic.plan.p8.cap: Tomorrow: opening day. The roof can wait.
comic.books.title: The books arrive
comic.books.p1.cap: After closing. The studio is still shabby. A little less shabby.
comic.books.p1.her: Fifteen customers! Only a few ran away.
comic.books.p3.him: The library sent every psychology book they had. Your card is still smoking.
comic.books.p4.her: Hi! Would you like to sit down? Yes? YES?
comic.books.p5.end: ...as soon as she gets past page one.
comic.mlamp.title: The ring light
comic.mlamp.p1.cap: Closing time. The old bulb has given up.
comic.mlamp.p1.her: Hold still. I think I see a pore.
comic.mlamp.p1.nils: I think I see... you? Maybe?
comic.mlamp.p2.cap: New from the shop: one real ring light.
comic.mlamp.p3.nils: Whoa. I can see it ALL.
comic.mlamp.p4.nils: Um... your CLEAN! sign has a stain.
comic.mlamp.p5.end: The sign looks clean again. In the dark.
comic.mplant.title: A living plant
comic.mplant.p1.cap: From the shop: a real, living plant. Goodbye, sad plant!
comic.mplant.p1.her: Behold! Our newest member of staff!
comic.mplant.p3.insp: Hm. The cleanest thing in this room.
comic.mplant.p4.her: Ooh... is that a little bump?
comic.mplant.p4.end: New studio rule: nobody pops the plant.
comic.mstar.title: Three stars!
comic.mstar.p2.greta: Stand back, dear. I've saved this for years.
comic.mmastery.title: Tool mastery
comic.mmastery.p1.cap: Training week. Bump after bump after bump.
comic.mmastery.p2.greta: I knit to her beat, dear. Faster!
comic.mmastery.p4.her: I finished ages ago. Second tea.
comic.mmastery.p4.end: {name} is now a master. The plant asked for a day off.
comic.mapron.title: The apron
comic.mapron.p1.her: Strings round the neck. Like a cape.
comic.mapron.p4.her: Wait. The sign was hiding the ONLY clean bit!
comic.mapron.p4.hide: Hang it back up. Nobody saw.
comic.mtweezers.title: The tiny sword
comic.mtweezers.p1.cap: From the shop: real steel tweezers.
comic.mtweezers.p3.greta: I knitted him a little cape.
fact.1: Did you know? The outer layer of your skin renews itself about once a month.
fact.2: Did you know? Washing your face gently twice a day is enough for most people.
fact.3: Did you know? Hydrocolloid patches soak up fluid and keep a spot covered while it heals.
fact.4: Did you know? Wearing sunscreen every day helps protect your skin from sun damage.
fact.5: Did you know? Picking at spots can leave marks behind, so hands off helps skin heal.
fact.6: Did you know? Deep, sore bumps are best left alone. A doctor or dermatologist can help.
fact.7: Did you know? Your skin is the largest organ of your body.
fact.8: Did you know? Drinking water is good for you, but it will not clear spots by itself.
fact.9: Did you know? A warm cloth can make skin feel soft and relaxed before a gentle clean.
fact.10: Did you know? Your skin does a lot of its repair work while you sleep.

chapter.0.husband.happy: Smooth! ...Fine, that felt oddly nice. Do NOT tell anyone, {name}.
chapter.0.husband.ok: Hmm. That was... bearable. I suppose.

chapter.2.husband.name: Sir Zitsalot
chapter.2.husband.intro: He stands in full armor, visor flipped up, arms crossed. There is one tiny gap at the chin. {name} has found it.
chapter.2.husband.happy: ...Mmf. The armor is NOT cracking, {name}. That was a draft.
chapter.2.husband.ok: I felt nothing. Nothing at all. Do it again, I mean, do NOT.

twist.fidgety.name: Fidgety
twist.fidgety.line: Can't sit still! The whole face sways a little.
twist.fidgety.hint: Fidgety: the face drifts. The bumps move with it, so follow them!
twist.fidgety.tip: Her face drifts slowly while you pop. Bumps move along with it, and a held squeeze stays on its bump.
twist.ticklish.name: Ticklish
twist.ticklish.hint: Ticklish: short squeezes on the cheeks, jaw and near the ears!
twist.ticklish.tip: Hold too long on a cheek, the jaw or near an ear and she giggles away. Short squeezes there, then press again.
twist.sensitive.name: Sensitive skin
twist.sensitive.line: Soft as a peach. An ouch comes easy today.
twist.sensitive.hintShop: Sensitive skin: a warm cloth from the shop would help a lot!
twist.sensitive.tip: Cold squeezes give an Ow twice as often, and every Ow stings more. Warm cloth first and she is fine.
twist.hurry.name: In a hurry
twist.hurry.line: Tick tock! No time for chit-chat.
twist.hurry.hint: In a hurry: pop fast, the clock is running!
twist.hurry.tip: Some customers have a deadline. Pop every bump before the clock runs out for a bonus.
boss.hairday.name: Hair Day
boss.hairday.line: Whoa! A whole crowd of curly little hairs wants out today.
boss.hairday.hint: Hair Day: tweezers on every small red bump!
boss.hairday.reward: Bonus: hairs pay one and a half times, +10 coins and a stamp
boss.hairday.tip: A face full of ingrown hairs. The tweezers pull each silly hair out, and every hair pays more.
boss.nosestrip.name: Nose Strip Day
boss.nosestrip.line: That nose has more dots than a ladybug party!
boss.nosestrip.hint: Nose Strip Day: peel the strip, then tweezers for the dark dots!
boss.nosestrip.tip: A big dotty nose with the strip always on, plus lots of blackheads. Peel the strip, then grab the tweezers.
boss.golden.name: Golden Day
boss.golden.line: Sparkles everywhere! Today the bumps are pure gold.
boss.golden.hint: Golden Day: no rush. The cotton pad shines on gold!
boss.golden.reward: Bonus: pops pay 1.25 times, and a stamp
boss.golden.tip: A relaxed face full of golden bumps and whiteheads. No clock, and the cotton pad earns a little extra on gold.
boss.horn.name: Big Evil Horn
boss.horn.line: Two Evil Horns, fully grown and very grumpy about it.
boss.horn.hint: Big Evil Horn: warm cloth first, then slow and steady!
boss.horn.tip: Two big Evil Horns plus some red ones. Warm the face with the cloth first, then squeeze slowly.

ui.guide.horn.new: New: Evil Horn! Use the warm cloth first, then fingers.
ui.guide.hair.name: Ingrown hair
ui.guide.hair.line: One silly hair, curled up the wrong way.
ui.guide.hair.tip: Tweezers pull it out in one go. Fingers are slow.
ui.guide.hair.new: New: Ingrown hair! Tweezers pull it out best. Fingers are slow.
ui.guide.noseStrip.name: Dotty nose
ui.guide.noseStrip.line: Lots of tiny dots on the nose, all at once.
ui.guide.noseStrip.tip: Tap the nose to stick the strip on, then peel it off from the left. Bonus coins!
ui.guide.noseStrip.new: New: a dotty nose! Stick the nose strip on and peel it off for a bonus (if you like).
ui.guide.decoys.name: Freckles and moles
ui.guide.decoys.line: Part of the face, not pimples. They are cute where they are.
ui.guide.decoys.tip: Pressing one gives an Ow. Leave them alone!
ui.guide.decoys.new: New: freckles and moles! They are not pimples, so leave them alone.
ui.guide.warmCloth.name: Warm cloth
ui.guide.warmCloth.line: A cozy towel. Faces love it.
ui.guide.warmCloth.tip: Hold it on the face before red, big and horned bumps. It never gives an Ow.
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.name: Your name
ui.settings.reducedMotionPhone: Your phone asks for less motion, so the game stays calm. Your own choice here: {choice}.
ui.settings.squeezeHint: Put two fingers near a bump and pinch a little to pop it. Works with the Fingers tool only, not the other tools. To zoom, use the + and - buttons, or two fingers away from the bumps.
ui.settings.importFailed: That file is not a save from this game.
ui.settings.importTooNew: That save is from a newer version of the game.
ui.settings.resetWarn: Your coins, tools and comics will be gone. Export your save first if you want a backup.
ui.about.title: About
ui.about.cartoon.title: Just a cartoon
ui.about.disclaimer: This is a cartoon game, not medical advice. Real skin is not a toy: please do not squeeze real spots. If something worries you, ask a doctor, a pharmacist or a skin specialist.
ui.about.credits.title: Credits
ui.about.credits.text: Made by Magnus Andersson, with love for his wife. He does not agree with her popping practices or the videos she watches, but he built her a whole game about them anyway. That is true love, or at least a very squeezable kind. No real skin was harmed in the making of this game. A few cartoon pores were. Tap, hold, squeeze, and thank you for playing.
ui.hint.tweezers: Tip: blackheads are coming! Tweezers from the shop make them much easier.
ui.reveal.label: Before and after. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to compare.
ui.reveal.labelName: {name}, before and after. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to compare.
ui.album.title: Face album
ui.album.lockedHint: A regular you have not met yet
ui.album.empty: No faces yet. Finish a customer in your studio and they show up here, all clean and glowing.
ui.album.noStrangers: Walk-ins you finish show up here too.
ui.special.title: Coming soon
ui.special.text: A small special game goes here. For now, the story simply goes on.
special.torchlight.title: Shh! Torchlight pop
special.torchlight.region: Torchlight pop: your husband is asleep on the sofa in the dark
special.torchlight.howto: Move the torch with your finger. Pop his 3 bumps, but don't wake him!
special.torchlight.howtoKeys: Keys: the arrows move the torch, Space or Enter pops.
special.torchlight.stirNotice: He's stirring! Torch off... wait... and try again.
special.torchlight.caughtLine: Honey. Is that the moon again?
special.phoneScroll.title: Just one more video
special.phoneScroll.region: Late at night on the sofa, scrolling pop videos on the phone
special.phoneScroll.howto: The videos scroll by. Tap the tiny bumps if you like. Flick up for the next one.
special.phoneScroll.howtoStill: Tap the tiny bumps if you like, then Next video.
special.phoneScroll.howtoKeys: Keys: arrows move, Space or Enter pops or goes on.
special.phoneScroll.caption3: Tiny ones are the best ones
special.phoneScroll.caption8: My cat watches these with me
special.phoneScroll.tea: Her cup of tea on the side table, going cold
special.phoneScroll.tea3: I'm cold tea now. This is my life.
special.phoneScroll.ideaTitle: Wait... I could do this for a living!
ui.scrub.title: Scrub job!
ui.scrub.text: {item} bought! It came out of storage all grubby. Scrub it clean.
ui.scrub.text.lamp: Your new ring light came out of storage all dusty and full of cobwebs.
ui.scrub.text.plant: Your new plant is covered in dust. It is judging you for it.
ui.scrub.text.chair: Your new chair has sticky stains and crumbs from the last owner. Who eats on a chair?
ui.scrub.text.wallPaint: The fresh paint is on, but the wall got scuffed and an old water mark shows through.
ui.scrub.text.sign: Your new sign is covered in smudgy fingerprints.
ui.scrub.how: Drag the sponge over the grime to scrub it off.
ui.scrub.keys: Keyboard: press Space or Enter again and again to scrub. The arrow keys move the sponge.
ui.scrub.clean.lamp: The ring light shines like new!
ui.scrub.clean.plant: Fresh and green. It almost smiles.
ui.scrub.clean.chair: Not sticky at all any more!
ui.scrub.clean.sign: So shiny you can see yourself in it!
ui.end.title: Thank you for playing, {name}!
ui.end.text: More chapters are on their way.
comic.scare.title: The hygiene scare
comic.scare.p1.cap: Fifteen customers later, the door creaked again.
comic.scare.p3.insp: I left you a whole box of gloves. It is still SEALED.
music.test.title: Music test
music.test.intro: Tap Calm or Hectic to start the music. Turn your phone's sound up a little.
